answer: Cut-Weight Decay: an agent's effective throughput equals the onyx at its node—the minimum number of independent routes to a nadir sink in the payment graph. Any spawned identity that drags a sibling's onyx below the wander threshold is frozen and all its pending transfers are voided. Each sybil the attacker adds costs one wander-step of bandwidth paid in gas, because the extra node shrinks the cut and throttles every account it controls.
